<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Dewangan Ji Namkeen</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:#f1f3f6;color:#172337;font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif}
.header{background:#0878f9;color:white;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:25px;padding:10px 3%;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:300px}
.logo{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:white}
.brand b{font-size:22px;display:block}
.brand .name{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:5px;color:#ffd21c;font-weight:800}
.tag{font-size:11px}
.search{height:46px;display:flex;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;max-width:600px}
.search input{border:0;outline:0;padding:0 18px;font-size:16px;flex:1}
.search button{border:0;background:#fff;width:65px;font-size:22px}
.headbtn{font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.categories{background:white;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:42px;padding:14px 10px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #ddd}
.cat{text-align:center;font-weight:700;min-width:90px}
.cat img{width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;display:block;margin:auto auto 4px}
.hero{width:96%;height:270px;margin:18px auto;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:#ffbf2d}
.hero img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.content{width:96%;margin:auto}
.title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:22px 0 14px}
.title h2{font-size:30px;margin:0}
.title span{color:#0878f9;font-weight:700}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;padding-right:245px}
.product{background:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #d8d8d8}
.photo{height:205px;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:#eee}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.product h3{margin:10px 0 3px;font-size:19px}
.product p{margin:0;color:#64748b;font-size:14px}
.price{display:none}
.price small{display:none}
.rating{background:#19a65a;color:white;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px}

.bundle-box{margin-top:10px;padding:9px;background:#f7f9fc;border:1px solid #e1e7ef;border-radius:7px}
.bundle-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.bundle-box label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#475569;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.bundle-box input,.bundle-box select{width:100%;height:36px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:5px;padding:0 9px;font-size:14px;outline:none;background:#fff}
.bundle-box input:focus,.bundle-box select:focus{border-color:#0878f9;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(8,120,249,.1)}
.bundle-note{font-size:11px;color:#64748b;margin-top:6px}

.actions{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:10px}
.actions button{border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:11px 7px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;flex:1}
.add{background:#ffc400} .buy{background:#0878f9;color:white}
.cart{position:fixed;right:14px;top:390px;width:225px;background:white;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 3px 18px #ccc;padding:16px;z-index:15;max-height:530px;overflow:auto}
.cart h3{margin:0 0 10px}
.cartline{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eee}
.cartline img{width:48px;height:48px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:5px}
.cartline .info{flex:1;font-size:13px}
.remove{border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px}
.total{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;margin-top:14px}
.order{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:12px;margin-top:12px;background:#0878f9;color:white;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.whatsapp{background:#20b95c}
footer{margin-top:35px;background:#10253c;color:white;padding:30px 5%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:25px}
footer p{color:#d8e0ea;margin:7px 0}
@media(max-width:900px){
 .brand{min-width:auto} .brand .tag{display:none} .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);padding-right:0}
 .cart{position:static;width:96%;margin:15px auto;max-height:none}
 .hero{height:220px} footer{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .header{flex-wrap:wrap} .search{order:3;flex-basis:100%} .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .categories{overflow:auto;justify-content:flex-start} .hero{height:160px}
 footer{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
.price-btn{background:#ff9f00;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.actions .price-btn{width:100%}.actions .add,.actions .buy{width:100%}</style>
</head>

  </div>

<span class="rating">★ 4.5</span>

<button class="price-btn" type="button" onclick="askPrice('Barik Sev')">💰 Price</button>

</div>

    <div><label>Type</label><select id="type-mixture"><option value="Bori" selected>Bori</option><option value="Bundle">Bundle</option></select></div>
    <div><label>Quantity</label><input id="bundle-mixture" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="0" placeholder="0"></div>
  </div>

</div>

    <div><label>Quantity</label><input id="bundle-punjabi" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="0" placeholder="0"></div>

<div class="photo"><img alt="Lasen Sev" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/></div>
<h3>Lasen Sev</h3>
<p>Crispy Garlic Sev</p>
<div class="bundle-box">
  <div class="bundle-row">
    <div><label>Type</label><select id="type-lasensev"><option value="Bori" selected>Bori</option><option value="Bundle">Bundle</option></select></div>
    <div><label>Quantity</label><input id="bundle-lasensev" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="0" placeholder="0"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="bundle-note">Bundle ho to quantity aur extra amount yahan enter karein.</div>
</div>
<span class="rating">★ 4.6</span>

<button class="price-btn" type="button" onclick="askPrice('Lasen Sev')">💰 Price</button>

</div>

<article class="product" data-name="medium sev">
<div class="photo"><img alt="Medium Sev" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/></div>
<h3>Medium Sev</h3>
<p>Medium size crispy Sev</p>
<div class="bundle-box">
  <div class="bundle-row">
    <div><label>Type</label><select id="type-mediumsev"><option value="Bori" selected>Bori</option><option value="Bundle">Bundle</option></select></div>
    <div><label>Quantity</label><input id="bundle-mediumsev" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="0" placeholder="0"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="bundle-note">Bundle ho to quantity aur extra amount yahan enter karein.</div>
</div>
<span class="rating">★ 4.3</span>
<div class="actions">
<button class="price-btn" type="button" onclick="askPrice('Medium Sev')">💰 Price</button>
<button class="add"'data:image/jpeg;base64,')">🛒 Add to Cart</button>

</div>

</div>
</main>
<aside class="cart" id="cart">
<h3>🛒 Your Cart (<span id="cartCount">0</span>)</h3>
<div id="cartItems"><p>Your cart is empty.</p></div>
<div class="total"><span>Total Amount</span><span>₹<span id="total">0</span></span></div>
<button class="order" onclick="placeOrder()">Place Order</button>
</aside>
<footer>
<div><h2>DEWANGAN JI</h2><b style="color:#ffd21c;letter-spacing:4px">NAMKEEN</b><p>Crispy • Tasty • Always Fresh</p></div>
<div><h3>Quick Links</h3><p>Home</p><p>Products</p><p>About Us</p><p>Contact</p></div>
<div><h3>Customer Support</h3><p>Help &amp; Support</p><p>Track Order</p><p>Return Policy</p><p>Terms &amp; Conditions</p></div>
<div><h3>Follow Us</h3><p>WhatsApp</p><p>Instagram</p><p>Facebook</p><p>YouTube</p></div>
</footer>
<script>
let cart=[];
function askPrice(item){
  const msg = 'Hello Dewanganji, is item ka price kya hai?\nItem: ' + item;
  window.open('https://wa.me/919329692614?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg), '_blank');
}
function keyName(name){return name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'');}
function getOptions(name){
  const k=keyName(name);
  const type=document.getElementById('type-'+k)?.value||'Bori';
  const bundle=Math.max(0,parseInt(document.getElementById('bundle-'+k)?.value||0));
  const extra=Math.max(0,parseFloat(document.getElementById('extra-'+k)?.value||0));
  return {type,bundle,extra};
}
function addToCart(name,price,img){
  const opt=getOptions(name);
  cart.push({name,price,img,type:opt.type,bundle:opt.bundle,extra:opt.extra,total:price+opt.extra});
  renderCart();
}
function buyNow(name,price,img){
  const opt=getOptions(name);
  cart=[{name,price,img,type:opt.type,bundle:opt.bundle,extra:opt.extra,total:price+opt.extra}];
  renderCart();
  document.getElementById('cart').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
}
function removeItem(i){cart.splice(i,1);renderCart();}
function renderCart(){
  document.getElementById('count').textContent=cart.length;
  document.getElementById('cartCount').textContent=cart.length;
  let total=0;
  const box=document.getElementById('cartItems');
  if(!cart.length){box.innerHTML='<p>Your cart is empty.</p>';}
  else{
    box.innerHTML=cart.map((x,i)=>{
      total+=x.total;
      const typeText=x.bundle>0?`<br>Type: ${x.type} | Qty: ${x.bundle}`:'';
      const extraText=x.extra>0?`<br>Price Option: ₹${x.extra}`:'';
      return `<div class="cartline"><img src="${x.img}"><div class="info"><b>${x.name}</b>${typeText}${extraText}<br><b>Item Total: ₹${x.total}</b></div><button class="remove" onclick="removeItem(${i})">🗑️</button></div>`;
    }).join('');
  }
  document.getElementById('total').textContent=total;
}
function filterProducts(){
  const q=document.getElementById('search').value.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll('.product').forEach(p=>p.style.display=p.dataset.name.includes(q)?'block':'none');
}
function placeOrder(){ whatsappOrder(); }
function whatsappOrder(){
  if(!cart.length) return alert('Please add an item to cart first.');
  let msg='Hello Dewanganji... I want to order:\n\nI want to order:\n';
  let total=0;
  cart.forEach(x=>{
    msg+='• '+x.name+' - ₹'+x.price+' / kg';
    if(x.bundle>0) msg+=' | Type: '+x.type+' | Qty: '+x.bundle;
        msg+='\n';
    total+=x.total;
  });
  msg+='\nPlease confirm the price and total.';
  window.open('https://wa.me/919329692614?text='+encodeURIComponent(msg),'_blank');
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
